title: A category picked on an existing matrix prices by it only after Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix made for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, left on Default for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Pick category A in the Categories picker.
  5. Close the picker.
  6. Open work order 1 in a second browser tab.
  7. Click Add Part under line 1.
  8. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  9. Type 1 in Qty.
  10. Pick category A in Category.
  11. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Go back to the first browser tab.
  14. Click Save.
  15. Go back to the second browser tab.
  16. Click Add Part under line 1.
  17. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  18. Type 1 in Qty.
  19. Pick category A in Category.
  20. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  21. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • Category A was listed with "Now:" and matrix B's name, and is now ticked.

Step 5:

  • The Categories line names category A at once, while the grid is still in edit.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 7:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 8:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 9:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 10:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 11:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 12:

  • The part's sell price fills in as $120.00, matrix B's price ($100.00 × 1.20 = $120.00), not matrix A's $150.00.

Step 13:

  • Matrix A's page still shows the grid in edit, with category A on the Categories line.

Step 14:

  • Matrix A saves and the grid returns to view.
  • The Categories line still names category A.

Step 15:

  • Work order 1 shows, with the first part at $120.00.

Step 16:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 17:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 18:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 19:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 20:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 21:

  • The new part's sell price fills in as $150.00, matrix A's price ($100.00 × 1.50 = $150.00).
  • The first part still reads $120.00.
